title: The Lycurgus Cup: The Roman Glass That Changes Color
excerpt: A fourth-century Roman cage cup glows ruby red when light passes through it. Silver–gold nanoparticles explain the color, but not everything about how it was made.

meta.advanced_seo_description: The Lycurgus Cup looks green in reflected light and ruby red when lit from behind. What British Museum scientists found in the glass, and what remains unknown.
